name: knowledge
description: Explain what code in your repo does, a code change in it, or a subject a research phase covered, as a native chapter — Markdown with typed blocks for diagrams, figures, callouts and a quiz — in your own knowledge base, written only from the code and what your workspace's phases recorded, a research phase's findings included, with no research of its own. Whenever the records lack what the reader needs (a subject no phase covers, code or not, or a covered subject that rests on outside basics no record states), it offers a research phase first, your own "research first" is always honoured, and the explain's confirmation comes back by itself when that research passes. It runs as an explain phase in a workflow workspace (v96 or later): one confirmation, then one writer, one critic and a private publish; a book's chapters are written at once. One setup skill connects the hosted KB or scaffolds your own.
